subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should ClawHub persist selected GitHub skill paths on `githubSkillSources` and treat an absent selection as legacy all-skills mode?
rationale: This changes durable source-configuration semantics and upgrade behavior for existing GitHub-backed sources, which automation cannot safely decide as a product contract.

options.title: Accept Persisted Selections
options.body: Keep `selectedSkillPaths` as the source contract, preserve absent selection as legacy all-skills mode, and fix the dry-run reporting inconsistency before merge.

options.title: Represent All-Vs-Selected Explicitly
options.body: Revise the model or UI so all-skills mode and selected-skills mode are separate explicit states rather than overloading an absent field.

options.title: Pause Source Selection
options.body: Keep the draft paused until maintainers decide whether subset sync belongs in this settings flow.

recommendation.title: Accept Persisted Selections
recommendation.body: Keep `selectedSkillPaths` as the source contract, preserve absent selection as legacy all-skills mode, and fix the dry-run reporting inconsistency before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the GitHub-backed source sync contract this PR extends.
